mapper.select: SELECT id, policy_no, order_id, product_id, level, premium, status, effective_from, effective_to FROM t_policy WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_policy (policy_no, order_id, product_id, level, premium, status, effective_from, effective_to, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{policyNo}, #{orderId}, #{productId}, #{level}, #{premium}, #{status}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo}, NOW(), NOW())
